subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should issue #10118 be completed as docs/help for existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, while the remaining request crosses from documentation into a compatibility-sensitive public configuration surface.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and TUI `/help` to expose Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback multiline composition without adding a new config surface.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Define a public config or CLI contract for TUI send/newline shortcuts and cover fresh-install plus upgrade behavior before implementation.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Decline docs/help and config follow-up because dependency-backed inline newline insertion is enough for the core request.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and TUI `/help` to expose Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback multiline composition without adding a new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Most closely connected to recent TUI editor dependency and docs/keybinding review history in this cluster.
